timeline.summary: HMT delayed the submission of its audited financial results for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, citing ongoing consolidation and audit across its units.
HMT submitted its annual promoter share encumbrance declaration under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations for FY26.
HMT received fines of ₹5.31 lakh each from BSE and NSE for non-compliance with board composition norms for Q4 FY26.
HMT CFO Smt. Aparna R resigns effective October 30, 2026, citing personal reasons
